transitions.reason: A shrinking residual-count window permits another representative rerun.
A non-shrinking residual-count window blocks another local rerun and requires a model, migration, or architecture route.
Fresh evidence that names another deciding owner exits the representative rerun pair.
Contradictory or unavailable evidence cannot authorize another local rerun.

properties.statement: When the latest residual-count window is non-shrinking, the next state is blocked_model_route rather than routeable_rerun.
A blocked model route exits only through owner-boundary migration or architecture/causal successor selection.

assumptions: Closed package residualCount values are artifact-bound and authoritative.
The active package does not edit runtime source while the representative pair is blocked.
Fresh representative evidence can resume only after the model route records a non-rerun successor or a shrinking residual window.
